title: Bricklayer enrolment repaired for mobile
details: QR images now scan inside Evia on Android and iPhone even when the browser has no built-in QR reader
The permanent Bricklayer code remains ST0095 and the QR remains EVIA1:ST0095
Manual ST0095 entry has a bundled fallback if the online registry cannot be reached
The public ST0095 PNG address now stays an image instead of reopening the app
The Bricklayer course pack and complete Beta shell remain available offline
